T2.v1: And all of this has got to lead somewhere, to a point where you notice you’re behaving more kindly, you’ve got more humility and better judgment than you had, you’re doing real service, or your ordinary life has gotten more workable.
T2.v2: And all of this has got to lead to something you’d see in yourself and in how your days go, whether that’s kinder behavior, more humility, better judgment, real service, or an ordinary life that’s more workable.
T2.keeps: Points: all of this ('it' anchored to the modes above) has got to lead somewhere, and the five places it can lead, any of them (kinder behavior, more humility, better judgment, real service, a more workable ordinary life). v1: 'has got to lead somewhere, to a point where you notice' + 'behaving more kindly', 'more humility and better judgment', 'doing real service', 'or your ordinary life has gotten more workable'. v2: 'has got to lead to something you’d see in yourself and in how your days go' + all five after 'whether that’s', with one closing 'or'.

T4.v1: For that starting point, I’ve developed a kind of provisional bridge, which I call “borrowed adulthood,” and while it’s built out of familiar practices like modeling and supported action, I’m not suggesting the whole sequence has been formally tested and proven as one treatment.
T4.v2: For that starting point, I’ve taken familiar practices like modeling and supported action and built them into a kind of provisional bridge I call “borrowed adulthood,” but I’m not suggesting anyone has formally tested and proven the whole sequence as one treatment.
T4.keeps: Points: for that starting point; I developed it; a kind of provisional bridge; named “borrowed adulthood”; built from familiar practices like modeling and supported action; contrast and caveat that the whole sequence isn’t claimed to be formally tested and proven as one treatment. v1 keeps that order in one sentence ('I’ve developed', 'which I call', 'while it’s built out of ..., I’m not suggesting'); v2 starts from the practices ('I’ve taken ... and built them into a kind of provisional bridge I call') and ends on 'but I’m not suggesting anyone has formally tested and proven the whole sequence as one treatment'.

T7.v1: If you’re using fractionation, you come back up toward ordinary awareness and then decide whether to go into absorption again, and if you do it openly it teaches you that a trance has a way out as well as a way in.
T7.v2: When you bring in fractionation, you come back up toward ordinary awareness, and then you decide whether you want to go into absorption again. You learn from doing fractionation openly that a trance is something you can leave as well as enter.
T7.keeps: Points: what fractionation is (coming back toward ordinary awareness, then deciding whether to enter absorption again) and what doing it openly teaches (trance has a door in both directions). v1, one sentence: 'If you’re using fractionation, you come back up toward ordinary awareness and then decide whether to go into absorption again' + 'if you do it openly it teaches you that a trance has a way out as well as a way in'. v2, two sentences: 'When you bring in fractionation, ... and then you decide whether you want to go into absorption again' + 'You learn from doing fractionation openly that a trance is something you can leave as well as enter'. Both name fractionation, so the next sentence’s 'add this' points to it.
